comment: Cliff faces cut from the story maps of the ROM (MAP_BG) by Tools/pmd/extract_cliffs.py into Resources/Cliffs/<style>/<role>_<n>.png (24×24, one tile each). map: the BMA name; layer: lower, upper (its transparent pixels kept) or both; pieces: per role, the top left corner (pixels) of each 24×24 piece in the rendered map, several = variants picked at random. Roles: top / middle / bottom (rows of a face, from the ground above it down), leftTop, leftBottom, rightTop, rightBottom (the ends of a face; middle rows use the bottom ones), rim (the thin edge on the other sides), stairsLeft/Mid/Right + Top/Bottom (stairs 3 tiles wide cut into a face), mouthLeft/Mid/Right + Top/Bottom (a cave's mouth in a face).
